title: Volcanoes of Asia (streak)
intro: 10 volcanoes of Asia, one after another. Three markers too far from the place end the run, so aim with care. The map shows coasts, rivers, lakes and borders, and you work inside this area.

rounds.name: Dolok Lubuk Raya
rounds.fact: Dolok Lubuk Raya is a volcano with a recorded summit elevation of 1,862 m in the source data. The data places it in Indonesia.

rounds.name: Ijen
rounds.fact: Ijen is a stratovolcano; the latest significant eruption recorded for it in the source data was in 2020. The data places it in Indonesia.

rounds.name: Mount Sindoro
